id.description: If the new document was created while offline, you can (optionally) request a specific uuid for the document.

title.description: Optional. Should be encrypted with the document key, and encoded as a base64 string

type.description: The type of this document, used to determine which editor to use.

created.description: If ommitted, it will be set to the upload time.

updated.description: If ommitted, it will be set to the upload time.

documentKey.description: The wrapped document key, encoded as a base64 string.

attachments.description: A list of all the attachments attached to this document.

authorizedUsers.description: The uuids of all the users who are allowed to read this document. This does *not* include the owner.

key.description: The document key, wrapped with the user's public key, encoded as a base64 string.
